high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "lindsaymariebrewer." The post was made 4 hours prior to the screenshot being taken at 2:17 PM. The user has a verified badge next to their username. The main focus of the image is a plush toy that resembles a character known as a "labubu," which is a type of collectible toy often associated with the artist Crybaby Hunter. The labubu is light orange with white fur and has large, expressive eyes with red irises and yellow accents. It also has small yellow horns on its head and a small tattoo
